The written order comes from a thread quoting a Jaguar technical guide. Wikipedia gives AJ26 as 1-2-7-3-4-5-6-8 and says the AJ37 string 1-5-4-2-6-3-7-8 is the same order with different numbering. Both strings land on the same physical sequence if the first counts 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B and so on, and the second counts 1 to 4 on A bank and 5 to 8 on B bank. That mapping is our reasoning, not a quote. A Jag-Lovers reply puts 1-4 on the right bank and 5-8 on the left with 1 and 5 at the front, and a Jaguar Owners Club thread is unsure which side is bank 1. Before chasing a cylinder code such as P0305, confirm the numbering in JTIS or with a coil swap: move the coil and see if the code follows.
